# .github/forbidden-pattern-allowlist.txt
#
# Allowlist for the "Scan for forbidden patterns" step in
# .github/workflows/policy-guard.yml.
#
# Format: one file path per line, relative to repo root. Comments start with '#'.
# A file that matches a forbidden pattern passes IF its path appears in this list.
# Any match in a file NOT in this list fails CI.
#
# The forbidden-pattern scan is a coarse secret/doctrine net. It matches on the
# bare strings `claude.ai`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`,
# `WRANGLER_`, `AWS_SECRET`, `PRIVATE KEY`, and `ghp_*` / `sk-*` shapes. Because
# it scans the whole tree, it also matches legitimate, non-secret references:
# env-var NAMES (not values), public connector URLs, and config-key declarations.
# Every entry below was verified to contain NO hardcoded secret value — only a
# name, a public URL, or a doc reference. Real secret VALUES are still caught
# anywhere, and any NEW file that trips the scan still fails.
#
# Per FOUNDER-DOCTRINE and the Opus-Guardian "Zero Secrets in Source" invariant:
# removing a file from this list (i.e. eliminating the reference) tightens the
# net. Adding a new entry MUST be accompanied by a rationale in the commit
# message and verification that the match is a name/URL/key-declaration, not a
# secret value.
#
# --- Doctrine-review note for Josh (awaiting-josh) ---------------------------
# apps/command-center/lib/data.ts represents Opus on the Mission Control surface
# with `api: "Anthropic API"` + `url: "https://claude.ai"`. command-center is an
# opus-only Tier-1 surface (the external orchestrator IS shown there), so this is
# doctrine-consistent, not in-platform-adapter drift. Allowlisted on that basis;
# confirm or have it reworded.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Gateway/router config — references the env-var NAME, value injected at runtime.
litellm-config.yaml

# This scanner's own pattern list (self-match) + the audit scanner that mirrors it.
.github/workflows/policy-guard.yml
bootstrap_hermes_audit.sh

# MCP server header comments documenting the public claude.ai remote-connector URL.
mcp-server/src/index.ts
mcp-server/src/sse-server.ts

# Watchdog hook doc string naming first-party Claude.ai as the authorized editor.
scripts/watchdog/memory-protection-hook.sh

# Reads CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from env by NAME; no value present.
scripts/clawx-control/codex-fleet-watcher.py

# Secret-NAME declarations (secretName mappings); values resolved from the vault.
brain-mcp/src/config.ts

# Env-var presence check / env-var-NAME mapping; no value present.
ClawX/src/server/routers.ts
ClawX/src/shared/ai-providers.ts

# Mission Control orchestrator entry — Opus shown as external Tier-1 (see note above).
apps/command-center/lib/data.ts

# Env-sync script moving keys by NAME between vault and Hermes env; no value present.
scripts/sync-master-env-to-hermes.sh

# Solidity deploy script — comment + env-var NAME for the deployer wallet key.
contracts/scripts/deploy-mission.js
